scope: Signature matching, HTML/XML/Office/CRX logic, binary classification and MIME/nosniff decisions in safe Rust. C++ retains GURL scheme-eligibility classification and conditional header extraction, borrowed metadata adaptation and std::string output ownership. Public C++ header/API unchanged.

properties.returned_mime_pointers: immutable static Rust strings, never input/output pointers
properties.boundary: private standard C ABI over pointer/length views and repr(C) POD; sizeof/alignment/offsets and bool width asserted in both languages; narrow documented unsafe input adapter
properties.borrow_lifetime: all input borrows end before C++ output assignment
properties.metadata_optimization: GURL::SchemeIs implementation compares scheme() to its literal after DCHECK validation; adapter uses equivalent borrowed scheme views, with no URL reparse or extra callbacks
properties.legacy_semantics: preserves signature order, wildcard/mask behavior, greedy C++ Canon CR2 hex escape, hint/output identity and content/output overlap/subviews, output on local misses, partial-data completion and first nosniff header
properties.content_output_alias_representation: borrowed mutable scratch slice, avoiding by-value1KiB array movement;64B capacity for input<=64B, otherwise1KiB; parser sees identical min(input,1024) bytes

signature_index.scope: local signatures and final network generic signatures; original order, wildcard and masks preserved by ascending candidate bits

native_tests.composition: 275 preexisting MIME tests +13 added differential/ABI families; per-family matrices include all signatures, every truncation and single-byte mutation, metadata/hint combinations,256byte classification, threshold boundaries and aliases

fuzz.instrumentation: libFuzzer native harness/reference coverage; Rust checked differentially, no Rust sanitizer-coverage or ASan claim

coverage.compiler: Chromium Rust1.101/LLVM24 with matching Chromium LLVM coverage_tools

compile_time_only_exclusions.reason: The only uncovered regions are unused runtime forms of three private const constructors and first_byte_index, invoked exclusively by static table/index initializers. No artificial runtime calls added.

coverage.runtime_aggregation: LLVM source lines/regions aggregate generic instantiations; no claim that each monomorphized path or branch was covered

checks.rust_format: Chromium nightly rustfmt --check --edition=2024 passed with repository configuration

benchmark_plan.includes: full public C++ API with raw-Rust boundary and output assignment; fresh output strings; alias cases include identical reset and capacity reservation

limitations: Raw LLVM line coverage91.515% including compile-time-only constructor/index bodies;100% stated only for explicitly defined runtime denominator
Early native prototype timings are retained in run selectors; final canonical GN run is authoritative

practical_equivalence.interval_method: 90% paired percentile bootstrap for absolute median-time difference
practical_equivalence.interpretation: Interval contained within predeclared bound; overlap with zero alone was not used as an equivalence test

aggregate.method: equal weight per each of30unique case median-time ratios; point estimate only
aggregate.scope: isolated full C++ public APIs plus adaptation/bridge/output cost, not whole-browser performance
